caption:
Milagai Podi Aloo Tikki
home food 101 | side dishes | south indian 

Nutrition:
C: 28 | F: 1 | P: 3
Calories: 136 per tikki
Makes 7 tikkis 

Ingredients: 
4 potatoes, boiled and peeled
1 onion, finely chopped
1 -2 green chillies, finely chopped
handful chopped coriander 
2 - 3 tbsp malaga podi, adjust basis how strong and flavourful your podi is 
1 tsp aamchur powder
1 tsp chaat masala 
1 tbsp cornflour 
salt to taste  1 tsp oil 

Method 
boil, peel and grate the potatoes
then combine all ingredients together and check the seasoning 
form the potato mix into tikkis 
add oil to the pan then add in your tikkis and fry till golden brown
alternatively, you can brush lightly with oil and airfry the tikkis
